# requires: wire
#
# The server was asked for bytes from 40 and sent the whole file from zero.
# Appending that to the prefix gives a file of plausible length and impossible
# content, which is what `curl -C -` does. download/README.md has said the
# runner never does it since the first day and no scenario could reach HTTP to
# find out, which is METHOD.md §8 exactly: a MUST nobody can fail.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:norange
claim A alpha 5000
stage A 40
progress A alpha 40 {"verified_prefix":40}
release A alpha
run A beta
state A

# expect 6: ok state=transferred [DL-R5]
# expect 6: done=64 err=none [DL-R6]
